name: Qualio
desc:
Customer Success Associate https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/qualio/jobs/7630284003
You are encouraged to apply if you're looking for something more than call center. This is NOT call center. If you have 1-2 years of working with customers in any capacity of customer satisfaction, please apply. This is a professional to business casual dress environment with heavy meetings and video communications. 

Note: The job description sounds "corporate" lingo but what this role is actually doing:
What this role does:
 You manage a group of business customers after they sign up, help them use the software, answer questions, and support renewals. You also help spot issues early if a customer seems confused, inactive, or frustrated so the team can step in and help.
Good fit if you have experience in:
 Customer service, call center support, healthcare support, front desk, admin, or any role where you had to communicate clearly, stay organized, and help people solve problems.

Keeping customers from falling off
Spotting issues early and getting help
Helping customers stay on track
Identifying unhappy customers before they leave


Why this still can be entry-level-ish
They’re asking for:
1–2 years customer-facing experience
communication
organization
ability to learn tools
That can absolutely include:
nursing home/front desk
call center support
retail/customer service
admin roles
hospitality
What matters is whether someone can:
talk to people professionally
stay organized
follow up
solve problems
not panic in meetings
That’s not “fancy background required.” That’s transferable skills.
